verdict: Meta is holding, but Google spend needs a fix before it restarts.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 145 leads at a cost of $17.69 per lead — all of them from Meta, which remains your only working lead channel. Google Ads received $1,074 of your budget over the same window and returned zero leads; the issue has been traced to a conversion tracking failure, not audience quality, as 171 clicks did reach your site. Google spend has been stepped down while that tracking is repaired, and offline conversion import is on track to go live by end of September, after which Google can run properly optimized. On Meta, daily lead volume softened this past week as spend pulled back, so cost per lead edged up 7.92% — that is being watched and creative refresh work is already in motion to protect efficiency.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, entirely through Meta
cost per lead this period, up slightly week over week
spent on Google this period with zero leads returned — tracking repair underway

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending with zero leads coming through — confirmed as a tracking failure, not an audience problem.
